query:
SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecules) as total_molecules,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plants) as total_plants,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plant_molecules) as total_links,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) FROM plant_molecules) as molecules_with_plant,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT plant_id) FROM plant_molecules) as plants_with_molecule
